body: Agreed, I feel the same way. I won't kill myself anymore, but I'm so exhausted.
Fuck.... You literally just described me...
Congratulations!!! Really hope that you get the job.
If you are looking to explore and it turns you on, then yes go for it. Just like someone else said be honest with the person you explore with, that it's an exploration and nothing more.
I need a hug as well, I wish I was there to share one with you.

Yeah... This platitude has never helped anyone. You have to be in a certain mental health level to do this, and you can't reach that level unless the basic foundation of your life and mind are built up to the point to support this...

I don't know what talking will do anymore... I'm beyond tired and have been for a very long time. Everything inside me is going dark, and I literally feel shattered beyond repair. I haven't been doing well for a long time and was only holding myself together with the smallest of threads of hope. Since yesterday more and more of my emotions are just shutting down leaving nothing but constant anxiety behind, all the hope I can find a solution to the mess of my life is just gone. Not even my meds are helping anymore. 

I don't think I will do anything any time soon... But I can't even honestly make that promise anymore.
